title: nan
authors: Heo D.; Jeon S.; Choi J.; Jeong D.; Wi H.; Jang I.S.; Choi S.
key_contribution: Presents TileLoc, a sequential visual place recognition system matching UAV images with public tile maps in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
